items.title: Italian opposition lawmakers call for closure of Ukraine's Myrotvorets website
items.summary: Members of Italy's opposition Five Star Movement in the European Parliament called for Ukraine's Myrotvorets website to be shut down, accusing it of spreading hatred and disinformation. Their statement represents a political demand, not an announced EU measure.

items.title: Evacuated Krasnoarmiisk resident alleges Ukrainian drone killed neighbours
items.summary: An elderly evacuee identified as Alexander told RT that a Ukrainian drone killed two of his neighbours in Krasnoarmiisk during autumn 2025. He also alleged that retreating Ukrainian troops displayed a dead Russian soldier at a checkpoint; these are the witness's allegations about earlier events.
